description: This file is a shell script designed to test Git's worktree operations related to skip-worktree flags, including setup steps, modifications, and checks for various edge cases in Git's behavior around sparse checkout and skip-worktree.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Prepares the Git index with specific files marked with skip-worktree in absent state.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Prepares the Git index with specific files in a dirty state, simulating modifications.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies the index and working directory state for dirty files.
